4387.title: OpenCode v2 credential lookup in Go usage
4387.rootCauseOneLine: The Go usage collector never reads active OpenCode v2 credential rows from SQLite, so a database-only key resolves to unauthenticated.
4387.proposedFix: Read and validate the active v2 key credential at the host-local collector, preserving precedence and read-only access.
4387.caveats: Synthetic v2.0.18-shaped database and mocked quota response; no real account used.
